description: Fork of Code Runner: multi-action picker, non-text file support (docx / exe / pdf), multi-segment file extensions, multi-selection concat run.
config.title: Run Code configuration
command.explain: Explain How This File Is Matched (Code Runner Pro)
command.showLanguageMap: Show Extension → Language Map (Code Runner Pro)
config.executorMapByGlob: Commands per file-name glob (micromatch). First match wins. A value may be a command, an array of commands, or an array of {label, command, description}.
config.executorMap: Commands per language id (as decided by VS Code, not by file extension).
config.executorMapByFileExtension: Commands per file extension. The longest matching suffix wins.
config.customCommand: Command used by the Run Custom Command command.
config.matchOrder: Order of the matching steps, separated by commas or spaces: shebang, glob, extension, language, default. The first step that hits stops the search. Leave it empty to use the default order.
config.defaultLanguage: Language used when no step matches.
config.cwd: Working directory of the executed command. Defaults to the file's directory.
config.fileDirectoryAsCwd: Use the file's folder as the working directory.
config.clearPreviousOutput: Clear previous output before each run.
config.showExecutionMessage: Show execution messages such as [Running] and [Done].
config.runInTerminal: Run in the integrated terminal instead of the Output panel.
config.terminalRoot: Replace the Windows drive letter in the command, e.g. /mnt/ when using WSL.
config.preserveFocus: Keep the focus in the editor when running.
config.ignoreSelection: Always run the whole file, ignoring the selection.
config.showRunIconInEditorTitleMenu: Show the run icon in the editor title menu.
config.showStopIconInEditorTitleMenu: Show the stop icon in the editor title menu while running.
config.showRunCommandInEditorContextMenu: Show the Run Code command in the editor context menu.
config.showRunCommandInExplorerContextMe: Show the Run Code command in the explorer context menu.
config.temporaryFileName: Base name of the temporary file used when running a selection. Empty means a random name.
config.respectShebang: Respect the shebang line and use it as the command.
config.multiActionBehavior: What to do when a file matches several commands: pick (ask every time, last used on top), last (reuse the last one), first (take the first one).
config.showTempCode: Print the generated temporary file content to the Output panel.
config.deleteTempFileAfterRun: Delete the temporary file after running a selection.
config.multiSelectionMode: Alt multi-selection behavior: concat (join all selections in document order) or primary (use only the main selection).
